name: knowledge
description: Search the local knowledge base indexed on this machine. Not for fetching web tables into Excel.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over the user's local knowledge base (~/.claude-excel-web/knowledge/). Use for internal SOP, policies, tariff notes the user uploaded. Returns snippets with docName and score — cite them in the reply. Not for public web research (use web_search) or structured table ingest (use /取数). If no hits, say so; do not invent policy text.

query.description: What to look up in local documents

docId.description: Optional document id to search within one file
